GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, battled on strong to the line # 1 better/Gap to 3rd
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards permitted rider to ride 1kg over the allotted weight of 57kg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 8l off 3 Wide No Cover , well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back & 3 Wide
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Got its head up in the early stages when being steadied from heels. Continued to race keenly for some distance and was then obliged to race wide and without cover throughout the event. Near the 400m was forced wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Four Wide No Cover (5L from lead). Held Ground midrace until pushed out Four Wide @ 500m & pushed along Five Wide @ 400m> Chasing Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 300m & ran on well in last 200m but just missed. # Wide/tried hard.
Jumped Well sat 4l off, swung Wide turn limited room, Straightened Up well off held up, clear passing 200m and ran on strong # needed room sooner
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped with rnr on jumping. Was held up for clear running over the concluding  stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 10 Lengths Two Wide , improved marginally to 9 Lengths Two Wide approaching turn, fanned rounding turn then hooked widest, out past centre of track, Straightening Up , ran on solidly down the outside in Straight # back/ ran on ok
Jumped Ok eased back 6-7l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on ok but never threatening # made some ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 150m was hampered and carried wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 2-3l off, pushed along turn, Straightened Up 2-3l off, plodded home # never a threat
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off but 3 Wide No Cover , ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, found little and dropped out # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside thus Settled Down 2nd last 9 Lengths Good Pace on with 1st following , Clear All The Way out Five Wide x 400m Kept Trying closest on line, # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 400m had to be checked to avoid heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok lay in bumped Restrained Settled Down Off Mid-Field Inside 7 Lengths much same to Straightening Up Ridden Along , plugged on one pace to the line - # couldn't quicken
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. Near the 150m was steadied when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 4-5l off but 3 Wide No Cover , pushed wider turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on strong after tough run # 3 wide/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
